segments.ja360:1.1: Vāti gandho timirānaṃ, kusamuddo ca [va (syā. pī.)] ghosavā;
segments.ja360:1.3: Dūre ito suyonandī [ito hi susandī (sī. syā.), itopi sussondī (pī.)], tambakāmā tudanti maṃ.
segments.ja360:2.1: Kathaṃ samuddamatari, kathaṃ addakkhi sedumaṃ [serumaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja360:2.3: Kathaṃ tassā ca tuyhañca, ahu sagga [agga (sī. syā.)] samāgamo.
segments.ja360:3.1: Kurukacchā [bharukacchā (sī. syā. pī.)] payātānaṃ, vāṇijānaṃ dhanesinaṃ;
segments.ja360:3.3: Makarehi abhidā [makarehibbhidā (sī.), makarehi’ bhidā (syā.), makarehi bhinnā (pī.)] nāvā, phalakenāhamaplaviṃ.
segments.ja360:4.1: Sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā, niccaṃ candanagandhinī;
segments.ja360:4.3: Aṅgena [aṅkena (pī. ka.)] uddharī bhaddā, mātā puttaṃva orasaṃ.
segments.ja360:5.1: Sā maṃ annena pānena, vatthena sayanena ca;
segments.ja360:5.3: Attanāpi ca mandakkhī, evaṃ tamba vijānāhīti.
segments.ja360:8.1: Atha jinavaro haritaṃ tiṇako, atha bhinnaplavo uragova ghaṭo;
segments.ja360:8.3: Dariyā puna kuñjara bhūnahatā, migamuttamasaggavarena dasāti.

lines: Taṃ kira nigrodhaṃ parivāretvā timirarukkhā atthi, te sandhāyevaṃ vadati.
Atha vā tambakāmāti tambena kāmitakāmā tambakāmā nāma.
Kathaṃ tassā ca tuyhañca, ahu sagga samāgamo”ti.
Aṅgena uddharī bhaddā, mātā puttaṃva orasaṃ.
“Sā maṃ annena pānena, vatthena sayanena ca;
Attanāpi ca mandakkhī, evaṃ tamba vijānahī”ti.
Tattha sā maṃ saṇhena mudunāti evaṃ phalakena tīraṃ uttiṇṇaṃ maṃ samuddatīre vicarantī sā disvā “mā bhāyī”ti saṇhena mudunā vacanena samassāsetvāti attho.
Sā maṃ annenāti sā maṃ etena annādinā santappesīti attho.
Attanāpi cāti na kevalaṃ annādīheva, attanāpi maṃ abhiramentī santappesīti dīpeti.
Mandakkhīti mandadassanī, mudunā ākārena olokanasīlāti vuttaṃ hoti.
“Mattakkhī” tipi pāṭho, madamattehi viya akkhīhi samannāgatāti attho.
